name: Positive RIG-I/MDA5 signaling to IRF3-driven type I interferon
rationale: All members concern dsRNA sensing by RIG-I/MDA5 driving IRF3-mediated type I IFN; unlike confusables it lacks negative regulators, cGAS/STING and NF-kB branches and pairs positive sensor regulation with IRF3 induction.

qualifier: contact activation (FXII/kallikrein) and von Willebrand factor variants
name: Contact activation (FXII/kallikrein) and von Willebrand factor defects
rationale: Members are FXII/kallikrein contact-pathway regulation and disease (angioedema, amyloid-induced FXII) plus VWF/GPIb/ADAMTS13 variants, distinct from confusables built on common-pathway coagulation, fibrin and F8/F9 defects.

name: Pyruvate and TCA-cycle carboxylate metabolism and transport
rationale: Members cover pyruvate oxidation to acetyl-CoA, malate/oxaloacetate/TCA metabolism and transport of pyruvate and di/tricarboxylates, unlike confusables centred on CoA synthesis, other SLC transporters, or succinate/2-oxoglutarate respiration.

name: Netrin axon guidance and DSCAM/sidekick dendrite self-avoidance
rationale: Members are netrin-driven axon extension/repulsion and DSCAM/SDK-mediated dendrite self-avoidance, distinguishing it from confusables built on ephrin, L1, semaphorin and Slit/Robo guidance.

name: Regulation of hydrogen peroxide- and hypoxia-induced intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Every member regulates intrinsic apoptosis triggered by H2O2/oxidative stress or hypoxia, unlike confusables about oxidative stress responses, respiration control or mitochondrial permeabilization per se.

qualifier: thymocyte selection, proliferation, survival and migration in thymus
name: Thymocyte development and thymic T cell selection
rationale: Members concern intrathymic T cell differentiation, positive/negative selection, thymocyte proliferation, apoptosis and migration, unlike confusables on peripheral T cell activation or bone marrow/B cell development.

qualifier: histamine, purinergic, leukotriene and prostanoid receptors
name: Histamine, purinergic, leukotriene and prostanoid GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are GPCR signaling for histamine, ATP/P2Y, leukotrienes and prostanoids, and the purinergic/NTPDase and histamine members separate it from confusables focused on eicosanoid synthesis and PLC/calcium signaling.

name: Maternal mRNA clearance at maternal-to-zygotic transition
rationale: Members describe deadenylation-driven M-decay and Z-decay of maternal mRNAs during the MZT, distinct from general mRNA decay/processing and MZT chromatin confusables.

qualifier: plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin expression
name: Plasma cell differentiation and immunoglobulin-expressing B cell signatures
rationale: Members are plasma cell/B cell immunoglobulin modules and plasma cell differentiation, which confusables lack in favour of memory, germinal centre or naive B cell signatures.

core: Fc receptor regulation of antibody effector responses
qualifier: ADCC, type II hypersensitivity, acute antigenic inflammation
name: Fc receptor control of antibody effector and hypersensitivity responses
rationale: Members are Fc receptor stimulatory/inhibitory signaling governing ADCC, type II hypersensitivity, phagocytosis and antigen-triggered acute inflammation, unlike confusables centred on FCGR phagocytic cup formation, BCR or neutrophil degranulation.

qualifier: TGFBR2, SMAD MH2 domains and TCF7L2
name: Cancer-associated mutants of TGF-beta receptor II, SMADs and TCF7L2
rationale: All members are cancer mutants of TGF-beta pathway components (TGFBR2, SMAD2/3/4 MH2) or TCF7L2, distinct from confusables on mismatch repair, normal TGF-beta signaling, TGFBR1 mutants or Hippo.

core: Small RNA biogenesis and gene silencing
qualifier: with splicing and mRNA processing repression
name: Small RNA biogenesis, gene silencing and splicing repression
rationale: Members are miRNA/siRNA biogenesis, RISC assembly, small-RNA silencing plus negative regulation of splicing/mRNA processing, unlike confusables on nuclear RNA processing, mRNA stability or specific miRNA-target regulation.

qualifier: NGF processing, NRIF/NADE death and NF-kB survival
name: NGF processing and p75NTR death/survival signaling
rationale: Members cover NGF/proNGF production and binding to p75NTR, its proteolysis and NRIF/NADE death or NF-kB survival outputs, distinguishing it from TRKA signaling and p75NTR RhoA/ceramide/axon-regeneration confusables.

name: GPI anchor and dolichyl phosphate biosynthesis
rationale: Members are GPI synthesis/attachment and dolichyl phosphate synthesis (including DHDDS disease), unlike confusables on nucleotide sugars, dolichyl-mannose CDGs or glycosphingolipids.

name: Platelet adhesion, activation and aggregation receptor signaling
rationale: Members are platelet receptor signaling (GPVI, GPIb-VWF, P2Y, PAR, TP, prostacyclin), degranulation and aggregation, unlike confusables focused on G12/13-Rho signaling or the plasma coagulation cascade.

qualifier: iron and heme uptake and transport
name: Iron and heme uptake, transport and systemic homeostasis
rationale: Members concern transferrin/iron import, ferroportin and DMT1 disorders, heme scavenging and transport, unlike confusables on other metals, scavenger receptors or heme biosynthesis.

name: Regulation of miRNA transcription and processing
rationale: All members regulate miRNA transcription, pri/pre-miRNA processing or metabolism, unlike confusables on miRNA silencing, target-directed miRNA decay or TGF-beta signaling.

name: Monocyte chemotaxis, extravasation and inflammatory activation
rationale: Members centre on monocyte chemotaxis regulation, CCR2/CX3CR1-driven recruitment, extravasation and inflammatory activation, unlike confusables on generic chemokines, monocyte surface signatures or leukocyte adhesion.

name: MITF-M activity and non-pigmentation target gene programs
rationale: All members are MITF-M regulation or its targets in proliferation, DNA repair, metabolism, autophagy, invasion and EMT, whereas confusables carry MITF-M pigmentation and melanin programs or other transcription factors.

name: Oxidative demethylation and catabolism of xenobiotics and alkaloids
rationale: Members are xenobiotic and alkaloid catabolism via oxidative N-dealkylation/demethylation, distinct from conjugation (acetylation, methylation, sulfonation) and FMO confusables.

name: Centriole and basal body control of cilium assembly and disassembly
rationale: Members link centrosome/centriole duplication and basal body docking to cilium assembly and disassembly, unlike confusables on intraflagellar transport, MTOC organization or mitotic spindles.

name: Glycolysis to lactate and fructose 2,6-bisphosphate regulation
rationale: Most members describe glucose catabolism to lactate and its control by fructose 2,6-bisphosphate (with oxygen transport and resveratrol as peripheral), which confusables lack in favour of gluconeogenesis, creatine or pentose-phosphate regulation.

name: HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of host immune surface receptors
rationale: Members are Nef/Vpu-driven downregulation and proteasomal degradation of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC class I, unlike confusables on HIV replication, MHC-I antigen presentation or PD-L1.

name: Alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase and secretion
rationale: Members are alpha-2 adrenergic Gi/Gz inhibition of adenylate cyclase and resulting suppression of catecholamine and insulin secretion, which confusables lack in favour of generic cAMP or PLC signaling.

name: NF-kappaB transcription factor activity regulation by SUMOylation and deubiquitination
rationale: Members regulate NF-kB and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, mostly negatively, with SUMOylation and deubiquitination, unlike confusables on upstream TNFR/TLR/IKK activation or DUB families alone.
